data.title: Bitcoin could hit $100K and Ethereum $4K by yea... | Pluang
data.description: Bitcoin reaching $100,000 and Ethereum hitting $4,000 by the end of 2026 are possible but conditional scenarios. Bitcoin needs sustained institutional demand, ETF inflows, and favorable Federal Reserve policies, while Ethereum requires increased network activity, DeFi growth, and a rising ETH/BTC ratio. Both targets face risks from macroeconomic stress and technical resistance. Investors should monitor market liquidity, trading volume, and asset-specific demand signals to assess the likelihood of these price milestones.
data.author: Coincu
